title: Apollo Belvedere
originalDesign: Traditionally attributed to Leochares, c. 330 BCE
depictedObject: Plaster cast in the Royal Cast Collection, SMK - National Gallery of Denmark, KAS353
originalStatue: Roman marble copy after an ancient Greek design; Museo Pio Clementino, Vatican Museums
rights: Public Domain Mark 1.0, as recorded by SMK for this official museum download
selectedListingRights: CC0 Public Domain, published by SMK - National Gallery of Denmark
sourceEquivalence: The museum record KAS353 directly links the selected Sketchfab Apollo model. This derivative uses the same museum object from the official SMK STL download; it is not an extraction of the Sketchfab viewer.
preparation: Blender 5.2 reduction from 290,254 to 55,000 triangles; smooth unit normals; single-sided opaque texture-free plaster PBR material; Draco-compressed glTF. Source proportions preserved with uniform height calibration. Integral scanned base retained; no additional display pedestal included.
dimensionNote: Height is calibrated to the SMK cast catalogue height of 232 cm. Scan proportions are preserved rather than stretched to catalogue width/depth measurements.

deviationAfterDraco.method: Bidirectional nearest-surface samples compared to normalized museum source after reimport of the final Draco GLB.

visualInspection: Front and back inspected in Blender source/optimized comparisons and in the actual Three.js Draco render. The chest faces +Z; the head turns toward the outstretched left arm.

curatorial.description: Apollo pauses after releasing an arrow. Follow the turn of his head, the outstretched arm and the sweep of drapery. This digital scan records the SMK plaster cast of the celebrated Vatican statue, a Roman marble version after an ancient Greek design.
curatorial.lookFor: The contrast between the relaxed torso and extended arm, and the deep folds hanging from the shoulder.
